name: AIIcon
description: Wraps any icon component with sizing, colour treatment, semantic tone, an optional container and motion. Governed by the 60-30-10 rule.
intent: A treatment layer over standard icons — not a new icon set.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

props.name: size
props.hint: See sizeGuidance in the mirror spec.

props.name: treatment
props.hint: One of the treatment values declared in aiIconVariants.

props.name: tone
props.hint: One of the tone values declared in aiIconVariants.

props.name: container
props.hint: One of the container values declared in aiIconVariants.

props.name: motion
props.hint: One of the motion values declared in aiIconVariants.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: Either label or decorative — one of the two, always
notes: Setting neither logs a development warning. An icon with meaning and no name is invisible.
Motion must reflect real activity. A permanently spinning icon is noise that trains users to ignore it.

agentRules: Set either label or decorative on every instance.
Reserve orange-signal for review and escalation.

gaps: The handoff-trail, completion-settle, nudge, shimmer and alert-ring motions from the source system are not implemented. Only spin and pulse.
